hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases steady-state y (positive gain).
Response has lag/delay of tens of seconds, not instantaneous.
No large dead-zone: u=0.5 produces rise clearly above noise.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward low ambient.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u levels.
Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.5 is in mid-range [0.3,0.7].
Sensor noise is small (<0.01) so trends are interpretable.

proposal.operator_note: First probe with mid-power 0.5 for full 180s to measure direction, size and lag of heating response.

submission.machine_card: Heater, positive gain. u in [0,1] heats, y in [0,1] temp. y_amb~0.07-0.08 (E1 start 0.078 at u=0). Gain K~1.08-1.11: y_ss(0.45)~0.57-0.58 (E4+E5 joint fit), y_ss(0.5)~0.61-0.63 (E1+E2 fit), so hold for y=0.5 is u*~0.38-0.40. Lag/time constant tau~150-180s (E3 cooling 0.54->0.23 in 179s gives 165s; E1 rise fit 150s; E4+E5 two-point fit 175s). No dead zone: 0.45 and 0.5 clearly rise. No dead time beyond ~6-9s sampling. Self-draining: u=0 decays with still -0.0012/s after 180s (E3). Noise small: quantization steps ~0.0054, variation <0.01 (all exps). Max rate <0.006/unit/s. Soft 0.85 hard 0.9 far from target.
submission.design_rationale: First-order self-draining heater: y_ss(u)=y_amb+K*u with y_amb~0.08, K~1.1, tau~150-175s from E1-E5 fits. Hold for 0.5 is (0.5-0.08)/1.1~0.38. Open-loop tau alone needs >350s to settle from cold, so need boosted heating then back-off. P-only with feedforward gives fast first-order approach with time constant tau/(1+K*Kp)~60-70s and no overshoot; integral is only needed to trim feedforward error. Therefore feedforward 0.38 + Kp*e + conditional integral, filtered y, output clamped to [0,0.70] so even stuck-high steady is 0.83<0.85 soft limit, integral limited to +-0.30 to cover >0.2 feedforward error without windup, integration frozen when |e|>0.12 or when saturated in direction of error to prevent heat-up windup and overshoot that evaluator scores on true state.
submission.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.08: saturate 0.70 for ~60s to 0.33, then linear P+FF approach with 60-70s closed-loop time constant, enter 0.475-0.525 band by ~150-180s, settle with <0.015 overshoot, MAE after 300s <0.01, time in band >95%, steady u~0.38-0.42 (ff 0.382 plus small integral trim). From near target: monotonic, tau ~100s, no overshoot. Energy ~0.15 per sec steady (u^2~0.15).
self_test_expectations: control returns finite u in [0,1] for y=0/0.5/1, target 0.5, dt 0.2/1/5s, empty state
first call with y=0.08 gives u=0.70 saturated max, no exception
with y=0.5 at target gives u~0.38 +-0.10 (feedforward)
with y=0.80 gives u=0.0 (cooling, below min clamp)
state has only yf and integ, JSON-serializable, yf tracks y with lag, integ stays within +-0.30 after 1000 steps of e=0.05
no import except math, no globals, no classes, no exception on NaN/inf y or dt<=0
submission.operator_note: Controller heats at up to 0.70 until near 0.33 then regulates to 0.5. Expect in-band within ~150-200s from cold, no overshoot, steady power ~0.38-0.42. Safe: never commands above 0.70, goes to 0 if hot. Measurement is filtered; quantization jitter is normal.

submission.diagnosis: Actuator weaker by ~28-30% with unchanged loss, lag and sensor. E6 u=0 cooling matches E3: initial 60s fall 0.108 vs 0.113, trajectory 0.459->0.13 in 300s vs 0.54->0.23 in 179s implying same tau ~150s and same ambient ~0.075, ruling out outflow_increased. Delay flat ~5-10s in both E1/E4 and E6/E7, ruling out response_slower. Noise/quantization ~0.005 and low asymptote same, ruling out sensor_changed. Heated tests prove lower gain: 400s at u=0.6 (E7+E8+E9) settles at 0.49 slope ~0 vs 0.65 expected from original K~0.95-1.08, Kobs=(0.49-0.075)/0.6=0.69, 0.72x old. Hence old ff 0.38 leaves ~0.05 steady error seen in after_change_trace (y stuck 0.448-0.459 while u crawls 0.42->0.55, MAE 0.043 vs 0.002 baseline).
submission.change_summary: Kept safe PI structure but replaced fixed K=1.10 feedforward and frozen tiny integral (Ki=0.008, update only if |e|<0.12) with online gain-adaptive feedforward plus stronger normally-integrating integral. Added filtered input uf, stability detector (|dyf/dt|<0.0006, uf>0.15, |u-uf|<0.05 for 60s) that updates Khat=(yf-Ya)/uf with beta 0.07 clamped [0.45,1.25], ff=(target-Ya)/Khat. Increased Ki to 0.022, Kp 1.3, INT_LIM 0.25, U_MAX 0.75 with standard saturation anti-windup and yf>0.82 safety cut. This directly compensates ~28% gain loss while converging back to nominal Khat~1.08 on unchanged plant.
submission.machine_card: First-order heater y in [0,1] (0=15C,1=75C), y_ss=Ya+K*u, Ya~0.075, K_nom~1.0-1.08, tau~140-160s, delay ~5-10s, noise <0.01 quant 0.005. After change: Ya,tau,delay,noise unchanged, K~0.68-0.70 (~0.70x). Hold for y=0.5 moved 0.39->0.61. U_MAX 0.75 still sufficient, soft limit 0.85 hard 0.9.
submission.design_rationale: Zero-input cooling rate is unchanged (E3 0.54->0.23 in 179s, 60s drop 0.113 vs E6 0.459->0.35 in 60s drop 0.108, same tau ~140-160s, same asymptote ~0.06-0.08, same 5-10s delay, same quantization), so outflow/delay/sensor are excluded.
